brief.headline: Ask Sayaji for faster payment in exchange for shaving ₹3–5/kg off dextrose — we're already at market-fair ₹66.48/KG, and three credible alternates give us walk-away power.

priceAsk.summary: Push for ₹61–63/kg, a ₹3–5/kg reduction from our current ₹66.48/KG
priceAsk.target: ₹61–63/kg (benchmarking toward the ₹60–81/kg market ask typical band of ₹66–73/kg)
priceAsk.basis: The market asking price for Anhydrous Dextrose IP sits at ₹60–81/kg (typical ₹66–73/kg), and our ₹66.48/KG is already MARKET-FAIR (slightly favourable). With three listed maize wet-millers offering exact-form dextrose as alternates, we have room to nudge lower — aim for the middle of that typical band or just below.

paymentTermAsk.summary: Offer to pay 15 days earlier (15 days instead of current 30 Days After Receipt) if they meet the target price
paymentTermAsk.cashImpact: ₹61.76 L of cash freed up for us

brief.financialLeverage: Sayaji publishes no financials, so we don't know their cash position or how big our ₹15.03 Cr spend is to them. That means we lean on our own data and the competitive landscape. We already pay them ₹66.48/KG — inside the market-fair band — so there's no burning fire to fix. But three listed alternates (Tirupati, Gulshan, Sanstar) all make the exact anhydrous dextrose form we need, and that gives us credible walk-away power. Push for a small price cut paired with faster payment; if they balk, we qualify one of those three as a second source.

evidence.point: Our current price from Sayaji is already market-fair, sitting inside the typical asking range
evidence.figure: ₹66.48/KG vs market ask ₹60–81/kg (typical ₹66–73/kg), verdict MARKET-FAIR (slightly favourable)

evidence.point: We spend ₹15.03 Cr a year with them — meaningful volume to negotiate on
Paying 15 days earlier frees up over half a crore of our cash
evidence.figure: ₹61.76 L working capital freed if we move to 15-day terms

evidence.point: India's export reference price for dextrose is far lower, signalling global competitiveness
We have no internal price gap to fix — Sayaji is already our best price
evidence.figure: 0.0% gap vs best; bestPriceWePay ₹66.48/KG from Sayaji Industries Limited

alternates.name: Tirupati Starch & Chemicals Ltd
alternates.why: Listed Indore maize wet-miller; makes Dextrose ANHYDROUS (IV-fluid grade) — exact form match; confirm IP monograph CoA before switching

alternates.name: Gulshan Polyols Ltd
alternates.why: Listed starch & polyol maker; established dextrose/sorbitol supplier — a drop-in alternate to Gujarat Ambuja/Sayaji

alternates.name: Sanstar Ltd
alternates.why: Recently-listed maize-derivatives specialist (starch, dextrose) — growing capacity

risks: Sayaji's finances aren't public, so we can't gauge how fragile or cash-starved they are — tread carefully and watch for any supply hiccups.
If we push too hard without a qualified backup ready, Sayaji could dig in and we'd have no second source approved to pivot to.
The three listed alternates are not yet qualified — each needs CoA review and an audit before we can actually switch volume.
Offering faster payment (15 days) gives away ₹61.76 L of our cash — only do it if we secure the ₹3–5/kg price cut in return.
brief.suggestedOpeningLine: We'd like to explore a win-win: we can pay you 15 days faster if you can sharpen your dextrose price by ₹3–5 per kilo — that puts us both closer to the middle of the market and improves our cash flow.
